definitions.gloss: formidable enemy; tough opponent; strong rival
definitions.explanation: A powerful adversary or competitor who is difficult to defeat. Used in contexts ranging from warfare and sports to business and everyday challenges.

examples.japanese: {強敵|きょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かう→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧。
⟦{決勝|けっしょう}→決勝：04742_kesshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{強敵|きょうてき}だった。
examples.english: The opponent in the finals was a tough one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{強敵|きょうてき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{競|きそ}う→競う：13767_kisou⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The new product will compete with many formidable rivals in the market.

notes:
Composed of {強|きょう} (strong) + ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧ (enemy, opponent). A versatile word used across many domains — sports, games, business, and literal conflict.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {強敵|きょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かう→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧: to face a formidable foe
- {強敵|きょうてき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{倒|たお}す→倒す：01954_taosu⟧: to defeat a strong enemy
- {強敵|きょうてき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧: a powerful rival appears
- {手強|てごわ}い{強敵|きょうてき}: a tough, formidable opponent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧: enemy, opponent (neutral; not necessarily strong)
- ⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧: rival (often implies mutual respect and ongoing competition)
- ⟦{好敵手|こうてきしゅ}→好敵手：16039_koutekishu⟧: worthy rival (emphasizes being well-matched)
